page.overview:
Who is Bowser Baddies crew?

A crew within the "Bowser Baddies" man the Koopa Cruiser. They are made up of Koopas typically dressed in aviation jackets and bomber hats.

Following Bowser's temporary alliance with the Mushroom Kingdom in Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga, they escort the Mario Bros. in flight to the Beanbean Kingdom alongside their barreled Goombas who are stowed away. In Mario & Luigi: Partners in Time they also escort Baby Mario, Baby Luigi, Baby Peach, and Toadsworth the Younger to Bowser's Castle.

Following Bowser's temporary alliance with the Mushroom Kingdom, he assembles a crew of his "Bowser Baddies" at Toad Town Square. One of them is lost and Mario and Luigi can direct him to the assembly area. At the assembly area, Bowser introduces his Koopa Cruiser. The crew board the ship and it takes off into the air.

Aboard the ship, the crew teach tutorials to the Mario Bros. on jumping, blocks, and how to fight. One of them also takes passport photos for the Bros. in order to cross the border. Some of the crew are seen doing duties like moving crates and stowing Goombas into barrels. After the Koopa Cruiser is destroyed by Fawful, wounded Koopa survivors are found in Stardust Fields. They ask the Bros. to find Lord Bowser and mention that they haven't finished paying off the Koopa Cruiser.
